items.topic: Premier Value Dental Floss Unwaxed 100 Yd
reviews: This is the second time i fall for the name that contains PREMIER, don't be fooled, this floss is nothing close to be a premium product it is substandard in fact. terrible product.

You need a pair of pliers to pull the floss out of the container, and the floss is almost like string. I don't like waxed dental floss and it's challenging to find unwaxed. But it looks like in the future I'll have to switch. Won't buy this one again.

This dental floss is super cheap and shreds and breaks while you’re flossing. It’s really a bummer that you can’t return it. You can’t find unwaxed dental floss in any store anymore and Amazon is the only place I’ve been able to find it. But if it doesn’t work you’re stuck with it.
Glad to be able to find unwaxed and unflavored dental floss because the drug stores do not carry such items. The price is a little high for me but I had to keep someone happy.

I have bought this product 3 times. I was perfectly satisfied with the first two orders, but the most recent (September, 2022) is clearly different. The floss is thinner and shreds easily. It slips from my finger even when wrapped around five times. In a word, the floss is useless.

This is the absolute worst dental floss I have ever used. It breaks off immediately when I try to pull a strand through my teeth. I used repeated strands among different spaces separating my teeth. They broke off every time. I very strongly recommend that you do not purchase this dental floss. It is horrible quality.

I should have listened to the negative reviews. This floss shreds and gets stuck between my teeth every time I use a piece. What an aggravation and waste of time. I need to go back to the CVS or Publix brand of unwaxed floss.

This is new packaging and I'm sure they have changed the product. It shreds like crazy and leaves strings in between tighter teeth that you have to try like heck to remove. Will never purchase it again. So disappointed.A waste of money.

sentences.text: Some reviewers praise its affordability, availability, and effectiveness
others criticize its poor quality, difficulty in finding unwaxed options, and tendency to break or shred during use
Poor quality, prone to breaking or shredding
Not recommended due to poor performance

items.topic: BUG HULL Pill Organizer 2 Times a Day Upgrade Version, Easy Open AM PM Pill Box with Push Open Button,
reviews: I thought this would be just what I needed--until the Thursday lid quit latching. This is especially a problem as you have to turn the whole thing upside down to retrieve the pills for each day, so the defective lid keeps dumping out pills for another day.

Wasn't sure about giving it a five-star on the traveling cuz it's kind of large but hey this is the organizer of organizers and must have if you are vitamin Nazi or just take a heck of a lot of pills during the day
Nice and large sections, easy to get pills out. Doors open with very little effort and close securely. I have tried many styles, this one has worked best by far!

Unfortunately, I take a lot of medicine so I needed something with a large capacity. I have no issues with fitting all my meds and supplements. I also have rheumatoid arthritis and can tell you that the functionality it easy on the joints. I

Easy to load with large compartments. A Little difficult to unload but the easy of storage and correct removal out weigh this problem. I dump the open one into my hand but as I get older I can see me dumping onto a towel to keep the little pills from bouncing.

Great pill box! I did have one of the boxes open while traveling; but overall it’s an amazing pill box for someone like me! I take a lot of meds twice a day, so this is awesome to fill up once a week, and to be able to take on the go! Great find.

It’s a lot bigger than I expected. Too big (for me) to take the whole thing when I travel. But no big deal...I just put all my pills in one sleeve, pop it out and take that. Like the hinged tops so they stay open making it much easier to fill than my previous case. It’s pretty large so it takes up a decent amount of counter space in my bathroom. I’m happy with it but just be cognizant of the size if you don’t have a lot of space as the picture is kind of deceiving.
Product is large and difficult to fill due to its design. One of the daily covers has already broken off and others are breaking. Very disappointed in the quality of this pill container.

sentences.text: The BUG HULL Pill Organizer 2 Times a Day Upgrade Version is generally well-received for its large compartments and ease of use, particularly for those taking multiple medications
However, some users have experienced issues with the lid not latching properly, causing pills to spill out, which can be inconvenient during travel
Additionally, the product is larger than anticipated, taking up significant counter space, and some users have reported quality concerns with the durability of the daily covers
Overall, despite these drawbacks, the organizer is praised for its functionality and convenience, making it a good choice for those who require a large capacity pill organizer

reviews: I've had bronchitis for two weeks and the tessalon pearles have not worked for me. What has worked, to sleep at night, is taking 2 Benadryl liquigels at bedtime. During the day I drink a lot of water, suck on ricola extra strength cough drops, and I have an albuterol inhaler.

Went to medical clinic with this annoying cough Dr. did the flu test..No flu Thank God!!!.she said I had a sinus Infection so she prescribe benzonatate 100mg 3x a day and a antibiotic...Took meds and on 3rd day still no relief..I'm going to pharmacy to buy over tha counter cough meds first thing in morning...ughhh waste of time and money..
it was a good and very helpful to relieve the cough. DONT CHEW IT! i wanted to see what it did and it felt like my throat was swelling up.

I started taking this due to my severe Sinusitis, I started noticing more frequent nightmares 4 nights in a row and decided to search this medication's side effects/symptoms as another medication has caused me nightmares. Sure enough there are many reports of nightmares, as well as, the medication having no improvements. I have no relief and will just take OTC cough meds again. DO NOT TAKE THIS MEDICATION!!!
I was prescribed this medicine to take 200mg 3 times daily for a cough. It did nothing for me after 30 mins of taking it I felt worse. I was coughing 10 times more after taking it.

Not impressed. Absolutely no relief. None! My cough has gotten worse. I can not stop coughing and I'm going crazy! I'm allergic to codeine, so my options are limited, but my next stop will be over the counter. No sense in wasting money on air when you can't breathe!

I have had a tremendous hacking cough with walking pneumonia. At my one week follow up, a coughing jag in front of the doctor made him immediately prescribe this drug in the 200mg dosage twice daily. I took it for the first time last night and felt a bit disoriented when it first kicked in. It kept me quiet for most of the night. No cough medicine is going to completely stop your coughing -- and I don't think you'd want it to. Having said that, I've gotten 8 hours of blessed relief and am grateful for this medicine.

4 days I've been taking this medication and it hasn't done anything what so ever! I can't get any rest because I'm coughing my brains out. I'm coughing so hard that I'm throwing up. My head is pounding. I will stop this so called "cough suppressant" today and go to the store and buy me some over the counter Robitussin because that works better than than this Prescription I had to pay outta pocket for because my insurance didn't cover it. I wouldn't recommend my worse enemy to take this medication!

sentences.text: The reviews for Benzonatate highlight its mixed effectiveness among users dealing with various respiratory issues
Some individuals found partial relief from their cough, particularly during nighttime
Others turned to over-the-counter (OTC) cough medicines like Robitussin
A few users also discussed being diagnosed with conditions like bronchitis, sinus infections, and walking pneumonia, and receiving prescriptions beyond Benzonatate, such as antibiotics

items.topic: Heating Pad Neck and Shoulder Heating Pad Heat Therapy Pad for Pain Relief, Non-Slip Fast Heating Wrap Electric Heating Pad
reviews: Pain from the muscles at the back of the neck and shoulders prompted me to buy this heating pad. It has various heat levels which worked in softening those muscle tissue which I deeply broke down using a massage wooden stick. Good for the cold winter season too. It’s made of soft smooth fabric which makes it comfortable and far from a synthetic feeling.
I found it pleasing, as my mother in law would say. The heating pad is in similar style to the 50’s “shoulder mink stole with the added advantage having long enough back length for extreme comfort.

DO NOT BUY THIS! After only using this one time it almost burnt my house down! I wanted to get a refund but after opening up this component and seeing it almost caught fire you couldn't pay me to use this brand again. I want my money back asap.

I have only had the Vivreal for a few days, but so far it has been great. It heats up quickly, is soft and comfortable. I wish it went a bit further down the back, but it is wonderful around the neck.

A great luxury heating pad for my neck and shoulders. I have severe arthritis in my neck and bone spurs. This heating pad has helped soothe my pain and relax my muscles. It arrived quickly and is exactly what was promised. I love how it's weighted and stays put. It's the first time I've been able to comfortably get heat to the part of my neck that hurts the most. So glad I found this product!

I bought this before I had neck surgery on 4 herniated discs. This neck and shoulder pad has been instrumental in keeping my shoulders more comfortable during this receovery time. So glad I purchased this one.

It's super soft, really comfortable, and seems to work well. My only two issues are the white plastic piece that the cord attaches to can sometimes jab you in the back, depending on where you're using it, and the thick ridge that rings the whole pad, which I assume is a coil of wires, can also be bulky and push on your back when you lean against it. That said, I would still definitely recommend it.

To be perfectly honest, I had purchased this neck and shoulder wrap for a gift to give to my friend. I fell in my apartment and sprained my shoulder. I couldn’t take the pain anymore and ended up opening thiis package. Oh my God! I was in pain relief heaven. This wrap was so warm and toasty and cracked my neck and shoulders with love. I would recommend this wrap to anyone who experience any type of neck/shoulder pain. This was a great investment. Had to buy another gift for my friend. LOL!

sentences.text: Some reviewers appreciated its soft and comfortable design
others noted some minor drawbacks such as a potentially bulky or irritating design element
this may have been a one-time defect
Overall, the majority of reviewers found the product helpful and recommended it for people experiencing neck and shoulder pain

reviews: I had my third injection 30 days ago. I find the improvement to my knee to be ongoing. Kind of a two steps forward one step back situation. I can now go up stairs almost normally. I no longer limp as I walk and the knee is relatively pain free. I have hopes that I will be able to play raquet ball again sometime in the future.

I had my first set of injections back in October 2012. I got almost immediate relief after a couple of days of swelling. It worked great for about three months then the effects started to wear off. I am hoping the second set of shots will work as well or better than the first.

I've had Synvisc One injections at least three times and each time they last anywhere from 6 to 8 months. The relief is awesome. I am careful not to overuse the knee and avoid many activities that I used to do that put undue stress on the knee, but I work full-time, stand for long periods of time, and ride a bike occasionally and Synvisc allows me to do this. However, I am in need of a new dose and this time I need to pay a co-insurance amount of over $400.00. This is far more than I used to pay, so I am not sure what is going on: same doctor, same insurance.

I received the synvisc one injection 3 months ago, it did not help my pain ,it causes me more pain and suffering. I barely can walk or sleep. The back of my knee after waking up to start my day, I can't bend my knee without extremely pain. A week after injection I had started dragging my leg because the pain is unbearable. How can I have this injection removed from my knee. I can't live with this very very very very bad pain from the synvisc one injection. the back and front of my knee is agony.

I had 4 rounds of Synvisc-One injections and took the last one May 31,2016 . It's been 5 months and I can barely walk .. I cannot straighten my leg and walk with a limp . These injections are not good. Wish I read reviews 1st. I Do Not recommend these injections at all . Wish I had just had the surgery

Had shot....shot was nothing...but 48 hrs. later I can barely stand the pain...elevating, ice, ibuprofen....but boy oh boy it hurts BAD. Gave birth to 3 children...one being breech....and swear this pain is worse.....I am hoping to be better soon....with this experience think I will not repeat this adventure. Do not think a knee replacement could be any worse than what I am going through right now!

I had a synvisc one injection in both knees about a week ago. Initially, I was told to expect pain and swelling for the first 48 hrs. So, I took it easy and stayed off me feet. As the week went on, the pain and swelling progressed. Exactly 7 days later, I ended up in the ER with excruciating pain , swelling and stiffness. The doctors removed 110cc's of fluid from my left knee alone. I was later released and told to follow up with my physician .To date, I am still in continuos pain and have difficulty walking. I wish I had never done this.
Had the 3 shots in 3 weeks. No results until about 2 months later. Very pleased at that time. Six months later, ready for another round of 3 shots & the return of relief.

sentences.text: Some reviewers experienced some relief from pain and swelling
the duration of relief varied
Some reviewers experienced serious complications, including severe pain, swelling, and even hospitalization, which led to the removal of excess fluid from their knee
some individuals may have experienced temporary relief from the injections, others were severely impacted by the procedure, leading to significant pain and long-term consequences

reviews: This is a miracle drug for me. I have spinal cord damage and I would pee my pants several times a day and had to use poise pads all the time . As a woman I was absolutely miserable because I never feel clean. I am so grateful to my physician for recommending this drug to me

Hi, I started taking this medicine six days ago and it has changed my life completely. I can go to the toilet normally (can't Remember the last time I could do that) and I no longer wake up in the night for the loo. Up to now I have had no side effects, bp fine and no tachycardia. I live in UK so I just buy a yearly prepaid prescription card to cover cost. This tablet is a God send

Only started yesterday, but in these 2 days - great. Number of trips to the bathroom during the day went from at least 12 to 5 yesterday and 6 today. I slept through the night last night without needing to get up once. Best of all, I was in the car running errands for over 2 hours and experienced absolutely no urgency. Small sample, but so far so good!

I have had Botox three times for incontinence and found relief for about six months each time. This medication works even better from the first pill. I have now been taking this for a month and it has changed my life. I was going to have the sacral nerve implant which was very frightening to me, but now I don't have to go through with it. I am a little bit upset that my doctor did not mention this medicine to me until I asked if there were any new medicines on the market. I have taken Detrol and Ditropan with no marked improvement. If you have an over active bladder this medication is fantastic.

I have had issues with bladder leakage for years. My doc did the mesh implant and I still have some, not as much, but some leaks. After a few questions, he determined that I had "over active bladder" problems as well. I've been on this medication now for about 6 weeks. At first, I was on 25 mg and still had not so perfect results, he bumped it up to 50 mg and I have no problems now. So far, no side effects and I'm thrilled with the results. Expensive, yes...there is a $50 card on their website, if that helps. I would definitely recommend.

Tried it for about two months. It had some effect, I suppose, but the pricing is unconscionable. Even with my insurance and the co-pay assistance, it cost me over $90 per month. Ridiculous. I'd rather wear the pads in my underwear.

After awakening and emptying a completely full bladder on myself and the floor, I called my doctor for help. Myrbetric was prescribed and has worked wonders. Having insurance that wouldn't cover this, I'm unfortunately having to try a different route. :(

I started Myrbetriq about three weeks ago. What a difference it has made in my life. The doctor gave me samples for 25 mg and I noticed a positive change the first day and even more after a few days. When my two week supply of samples ran out, I requested to try the 50 mg and this level has almost completely alleviated all the symptoms I was having. Now I'm battling with my insurance company to approve the medicine. Hopefully they will come through for me because this medication is working great.

sentences.text: The reviewers are extremely satisfied with Mirabegron, a medication used to treat overactive bladder and incontinence

They report significant improvements in their symptoms, including reduced frequency of urination, improved ability to control bowel movements, and reduced need for medical interventions like catheters or surgery
Some reviewers have experienced side effects, such as increased heart rate and blood pressure
The medication has also helped reduce reliance on medical devices like poise pads and catheters

items.topic: 10Pack(5Pair) Plantar Fasciitis Inserts Pads,Gel Heel Cushion,Silicone Heel Protectors,Heel Guards & Heel Cups to Repair Dry Cracked Heel and Reduce
reviews: These worked well on dry cracked heels, as nothing else did. I tried to adhere some of the torn ones at the instep but it did not work. I still wear the torn ones and wash at each wearing. The sock holds them in place well. Nothing like foot pain to create a bad review, but these do pretty good for a while. I wear them with no show socks and Keen sandals.

Crap product without manufacturer name, production date and lot number , I believe it was made by the underground plant somewhere on earth. Also I have slippery problem during the first day to use it.
Within less than an hour my feet were covered in hives - red, swollen with a red rash under the product. Took a few days to return to normal. I really wanted these to work.

I've tried two of the pairs. The first time, the silicone socks kept moving and rolling up my heel. I would push it back into place for it to slide up again. The second time, as some as I put them on, they ripped open.

I have very dry heels. These have been a game changer. They keep moisture in and in just a couple of days, my heels are looking much better. I teach and often have foot pain but with school going online due to covid-19, I can't speak for that yet. I can say they are very comfortable and i forget Im wearing them.
These didnot work. They tear easily the first one i put one torn. I return them back and didn't even receive my refund. Will not order from this seller again.

I would recommend these heel cups for anyone who has heel spurs. I received them 4 days ago and automatically put them on. Noticed a difference right off. Slept in them one night they stick to my blanket sheets but managed to sleep. Day 1- I had slight pain in my left heel. Day 2- very little pain. Day 3- no pain until I wore them with a gel insole and ended up taking that out and pain went away. I had xrays in November with heel spur on left foot and also one on back of same heel. So far with this product it has made pain go away and heels is smoother.
I wish it was a bit thicker, easy to wear, I wish it had come with care instructions, like how many times can you wear it, can they be washed,?

sentences.text: The 10Pack(5Pair) Plantar Fasciitis Inserts Pads have mixed results
However, others experienced issues such as slipping, tearing, and allergic reactions
A few reviewers reported significant relief from heel pain, including those with heel spurs, after using the products for a short period
Nevertheless, some users encountered problems with the product's durability, ease of wear, and lack of clear care instructions

reviews: I have found that a cup of this tea and moments of meditation really improve the start of my day, and I can plan out what I'd like to accomplish.

It really does make a difference in how I feel. My skin really likes it. This product in addition to Ching Chun Bao (Qing Chun Bao), which I also bought on line from Amazon in the same order, has reduced my need for Coumadin.

i ordered this for my father, it was a product he heard about, and as far as i can tell he loves it. I can rate for myself as it was not purchased for me. I have no idea what this is or its benefits just that my father seems to like it.

I've been taking Cho Wa almost daily for less than a month and have found that my energy has increased and I am now able to get to sleep at night without having to take a bunch of sleep aids. It took a couple of weeks for the good sleep effect to kick in, and now I can count on it most of the time. I really liked reading a review that said it helped to decrease the person's hair loss and am looking forward to seeing my own hair start to get thicker. When I drink it first thing in the morning, I seem more able to focus and get things done.

Both my husband and I had allergy issues with the product. We were having to take our allergy medicine everyday when we normally do not have too. I gave me a headache on the full package so I tried reducing it and found that a quarter package did not give me a headache. Will not purchase again.

I have been using Chow-Wa for over five years. It clears my mind, makes me feel calm and alert. I would recommend it for all people because of the super herbs in the tea and especially for people who sometimes get depressed.

Pleased to find it is both calming and mentally sharpening. Its a good alternative to morning coffee, but I prefer a cup in the afternoon to avoid a mental slump when there is still lots of work to be done! Nice product.
Purchased this for my boyfriend and he loves it. It has a pleasant taste and seems to make him feel better. And if he feels better and doesn't whine, that great for me.

sentences.text: Many reviewers have reported positive experiences with the product, citing improved sleep quality, reduced allergy symptoms, and enhanced mental clarity
Some users have also mentioned that it helps with skin health and hair growth
However, some reviewers have noted potential side effects such as headaches and allergic reactions
Overall, the majority of reviewers highly recommend CHO-WA tea for its overall well-being and versatility

items.topic: Chem-Dry Professional Strength Spot Remover 20 Oz (2 Pack)
reviews: I had this before from a Chem Dry rep and it worked perfectly. This one comes out way too fast and soaks the carpet if you’re not careful. I tried to return it after the first use but because it’s aerosol, it’s not permitted. 👎
Ive bought two recent ones and they stopped spraying out. Ive thrown two away. It was a waste of money. The bottles were still full only used them once or twice. I'm very disappointed!

Im also a long term Chem-Dry user and fan but I've become victim like so many on here that bought the product only to get 3 sprays of use out of it. then it stops dispensing the fluid. All I get is bubbles and malfunctioning button with a full bottle of product remaining. Since this is not the first time this issue is being reported, we can only assume that Chem Dry is selling their worst product to Amazon. Dont buy it. Never ever again. Chem Dry has lost its remarkable reputation.

This is the most effective carpet cleaner I've ever used on a variety of spills and mishaps. Takes out everything (except pet urine) and doesn't leave any residuals that may encourage stains to reappear. Even works on vomit!

This used to be a wonderful cleaning product. Since the company changed the nozzle, it's impossible to use. The spray goes everywhere and makes a mess of the very item you are trying to clean. I will never purchase this item again, and I will tell my friends not to purchase it also.

I have always liked Chem Dry products, but I have ordered 4 of the Spot Remover Professional Strength and they spray maybe 2 or 3 times, and then that's it. The last 3 cans have had 1/2 or more left in the can that will not spray out. So disappointing and quite a WASTE of my money to say the least!!!

WOW! Chem-Dry professional carpet cleaner is a miracle in a spray can. I have used it for years to remove spots on the carpets, nothing else cleans as well. (I did buy special carpet cleaner for puppy urine because Chem-Dry couldn't get all of the odor out.) Otherwise, that's the only carpet spotting it didn't completely remove. You gotta try Chem-Dry!

It ruined my carpet leaving it yellow. A spot I did not try this on I used Resolve and it worked great. Of course Amazon will not return the money. I am out $50 plus I will have to replace the carpet. DO NOT BUY this product!!

sentences.text: Users appreciate its ability to tackle tough spots without leaving residues
However, several negative reviews indicate significant issues with the product's functionality
Many customers report that the spray nozzles malfunction, releasing the contents too quickly or not at all, leading to wasted product and disappointment
some find the Chem-Dry Professional Strength Spot Remover highly effective, others face frustrating malfunctions and potential damage to their belongings, making it a polarizing product among users

reviews: My daughter barely benefited - if at all - from taking Tamiflu. She began taking Tamiflu liquid on the first day of contracting the flu (her annual flu shot failed to protect her). A week later she still has flu symptoms, though they remain moderate and never became severe. Her fever peaked at 103F, is now 100.5. Her nose remains stuffy, she still has a mild cough and body aches. Overall I am fairly dissatisfied with this product, especially considering the high cost of $86 after insurance.
For me it was incredible, in few hours I saw the improvement, without side effects, always take it with food. Truly effective, to eliminate the annoying symptoms of a bad flu.

My daughter, 11 yo, was prescribed Tamiflu for influenza A. She took it for a day, it helped to break the fever but at a high cost of the worst nausea in her life. We decided to discontinue taking it as side effects are worse than flu symptoms on their own. Please be cautious of severe nausea if you decide to take Tamiflu.

Both my husband and I were diagnosed with influenza A and prescribed generic Tamiflu. I Experienced severe vomiting about 60 minutes after taking each dose. Vomiting is the most freqent side effect listed in the insert. Not sure if the few doses I took did anything at all, except for completely clearing out my stomach. My husband did not tolerate the medicine well either, although he did not have the vomiting that I experienced.

I started taking it on day 2 after dr prescribed. Although I gained some strength back but the tremendous headache, nauseousness, vomiting and diarrhea was horrible. The worst part was insomnia, could barely sleep, only slept 2-3 hrs the most at each time, body still aching.

I began Tamiflu on my second day of fever. Vomiting/nauseous within an hour of taking it. Keep at it for 3 more doses then this morning didn't take any. I'll consider the vaccine next year! Other products you can return for a refund if dissatisfied. Wonder how that would go over?

I was prescribed tamiflu Tuesday evening, took my first dose shortly after getting home from doc. I ate a small meal as it said to but nonetheless an hour or two later I was throwing up, felt horrible. I stopped taking this medication after the one dose and the next day I felt better. I hate this medication and will not take again.

I got Influenza A from my son. It was to late for him to take Tamiflu, but his doctor prescribed it for me in case I came down with the flu. I took it with in the first 48 hrs. of beginning symptoms. I had little stomach upset and lose stool, but not to bad. I don't know that it did anything to help me. The only difference between me and my son was my fever stayed lower than his did. I was still just as sick and for the same period of days. The pharmacy info. on Tamiflu says it doesn't always help everyone. :(

sentences.text: others reported minimal benefits or even worsening of their condition
Common side effects include nausea, vomiting, and stomach issues, which may outweigh the potential benefits for some individuals
However, a few reviewers noted that the medication worked effectively for them, particularly when taken early in the course of the illness
Ultimately, the decision to use Tamiflu should be made in consultation with a healthcare professional, weighing the potential risks and benefits against other treatment options

items.topic: Flushable Wipes for Baby and Kids by Kandoo, Unscented for Sensitive Skin, Hypoallergenic Potty Training Wet Cleansing Cloths, 42 Count,
reviews: The box that should have contained 12 pieces only contained 11. Returns are not practical due to Covid-19 issues and I resent paying for something I did not receive. This will not happen again. The product was removed from Subscribe and Save.

Bought these to replace another brand and am very dissapointed. They are smaller; too small to use without getting.... stuff on your hands. They are also very thin and ... stuff... seeps through. Avoid these at all costs.

Even when flushing only the recommended amount, we ended up with clog in our main sewer line which backed up into our home, filling our bathroom and garage with sewage and piles of these wipes, which had not broken down in any way since they were flushed weeks ago. We needed to have both a plumber out as well as a cleanup service. If you are looking for a flushable wipe that is safe for your plumbing, this is not it.
My bottom is RAW!!! These wipes took the skin off my bottom! After only using them for a week I had a bloody bottom. I would NEVER use these on a child or baby. These are TERRIBLE!

I use this at home and when traveling for when my 2 yo goes number 2. He thinks toilet paper is too rough and loves these wet wipes. Love that it actually seals after each use and doesn't dry out. I've already reordered a couple times.

I purchased Kandoo flushable wipes from my local grocery store and have been using them for a few months during potty training. The other day my landlord showed me a pile of old wipes that became sucked into his septic pump and caused it to cease up! I did call Kandoo and they state that they will reimburse us some of our costs. It is my recommendation that everyone google these wipes and read all of the horror stories about flushing them before putting them in your toilet! Please save yourself ALOT of money and put them in the trash when done!

It took my child having such a horrible irritation that warranted a doctor visit for me to realize that a SENSITIVE wipe contained alcohol. I have always bought the Kandoo brand but this was the first and last time buying them. Even my pediatrician was perplexed why a wipe labeled sensitive would have an alcohol ingredient. Returning and requesting a full refund won't cover the doctor cost or prescription but on principle I want my money back. DO NOT BUY!
There are a million products that you should not flush down your pipes if you care for your plumbing or for the fact that you may be ruining public sanitation. This is one of them. NOT FLUSHABLE!

sentences.text: Some have experienced severe irritation, allergic reactions, and even sewage backups, leading to costly repairs
Some reviewers have experienced severe irritation, allergic reactions, and sewage backups, despite using the product as directed
COVID-19-related issues led to returns and requests for refunds, highlighting the company's failure to prioritize customer safety
Some reviewers suffered a severe reaction, requiring medical attention and a doctor's visit

reviews: Please please please.......If your doctor suggests this drug to you, do your research. I am 18 and just put full trust in my doctor when she told me to take it. 7 months later and I wish I never ever took it. I usually take my 150mg dose when I wake up in the morning and now I cannot even go until 11 pm at night if I forget to take it without having withdrawals. I experience nausea and feel uneasy on my feet as well as shakiness. It is ridiculous and I write this to stress that this is not a light topic. BE CAREFUL!!!!!

I had a major breakdown and was hospitalized. My psychiatrist put me on effexor. I took it before bed and by 2 am I was running fever and felt like I had the flu. It was by far the worst medicine I have ever tried. EVER. I woul never take this again. I felt horrible all day the next day and wouldn't get out of bed. It was a nightmare.

I've been using 75mg Effexor for 9 weeks now and it has changed my life. I wake up looking forward to the day and can remain focused throughout. I woke up on my 30th Birthday feeling very depressed and could not believe that's how I felt everyday before taking Effexor. My libido is back to where it was a year ago and the only side effect I experience is an upset stomach during very intense work outs. I see a therapist and that too has helped. My wife says I'm now a different person.

My experience with Effexor was so bad. The withdrawal was a nightmare, and being on Effexor made me like a zombie. I was not sad but I wasn't happy either. 6 years later I'm completely happy and antidepressant free.

I read all the reviews and still thought I could beat the odds and it "might" work for me. The first day of taking it I was so shaky, nauseous, and it made me even more depressed than usual. I am not on any other meds so I figured I would try this first since my doctor just kept recommending it to me. NEVER AGAIN!!! Even if you think your that 1 in a million who won't get the side effects don't risk it!! There's so many others out there to try it's not even worth the one day of being suicidal and miserable

Barely took the edge off of my anxiety AND made me severely depressed. After a week of trying to consult a doctor about the depression I gave up and quit cold turkey. The withdrawal symptoms were bad. Never again.

WARNING: Discontinuation Syndrome is the WORST I have ever experienced. I previously took a max dose of Zoloft and it took 6 months to titrate off the medicine. I have taken 37.5 mgs of Effexor the minimum dose (see my review under Depression) for 6 weeks and I have switched medicines and am still suffering daily "brain zaps". My doctor's concern is significant enough to re-prescribe Effexor to rid me of the residual withdrawal symptoms.

I am 140 lb, 29 year old woman. I was prescribed 150 mg of Venlafaxine XR. I only took it for 5 days due to the horrendous side effects. I experienced dry mouth, excessive sweating, blurred vision, constipation, and increased heart rate. I wasn't on it long enough to determine its effectiveness; I wasn't willing to deal with side effects. My doctor switched me to Wellbutrin and I have not experienced any withdrawal symptoms.

sentences.text: Warning: Effexor (Venlafaxine) can cause severe side effects, including withdrawal symptoms, nausea, dizziness, and changes in mood
Some users experienced a significant improvement in their mental health
Common side effects: Nausea, dizziness, shakiness, dry mouth, excessive sweating, blurred vision, constipation, and increased heart rate
Some users reported improved mood, reduced anxiety, and increased energy levels after taking Effexor

reviews: I was also hit hard with rheumatoid arthritis in 2011. Tried prednisone, followed by methotrexate pills, Arava and others, nothing helped. In 2012 I was put on Humira which helped a lot for a few months, but not enough. Since January 2013 I use Simponi along with 0.8 ml methotrexate injections, and it has given me back my quality of life. After 1 1/2 years I could bend my pinky finger again, wow! For me the change was subtle, but very effective. I tried alternative meds etc. after being diagnosed and didn't want to take this route, but honestly I cannot live without it. For me it works, it's a miracle.

I have been on Simponi since five years ago. The medicine has been a miracle. I did notice the effect only after one or two weeks. After five years I have started to have increased pain and I think the effect of the medicine is loosing. However, Simponi has changed my life completely. From hard attacked by Bekterew, I have now been running and cycling (100 km) competition for many years.

Had 1st shot of Simponi and didn't notice any change. I was also taking 2 pills of methotrexate. Doc upped methotrexate to 6 pills. I had been getting muscle spasms intermittently since starting Simponi. After 3rd shot, I got the muscle spasms the next day and they lasted for a week. Doc took me off Simponi due to the muscle spasms and also because I didn't notice any change in AS.
Good for the first 3 years but starting to loose its effectiveness. Very expensive most insurance company refuses to cover the cost. So it's great if you are wealthy or have great insurance.

Was diagnosed with osteoporosis in 2000 and ankylosing spondylitis in 2003. I have been put on different medications for both. I have been on Simponi for about 6 months and have not noticed any improvement. It is easy to use but that is about all.

I'm a mid to severe RA patient. I have RA for about 4.5 years. I was quickly diagnosed. Less then 6 months I was prescribed Simponi. In Canada my doctor got me lined up for Simponi and once I started they will give it to me free of charge. The drug company pays for it. I am very lucky. I have been in remission for since I started it 4 years ago. Colin

I am 3 weeks into my second dose of Simponi. Was on Enbrel for 4 1/2 yrs. with good results then it stopped working. the numerous side effects following my first dose came close to keeping me from trying a second month. this month i have had diarrhea for 3 weeks but that's an improvement over last month. joint pain, stiffness are better; but no effect on fatigue so far. It takes 6-8 weeks to know for sure how it will work. It is not possible to see results in hours or days. I have decided to try one more month since my next step is infusion mediciness.

My rheumatoid arthritis developed about three years ago and was very severe .. very debilitating. Walked at tortoise-pace, couldn't do anything around the house. I've now been on Simponi golimumab prefilled syringes for almost that long, in conjunction with weekly injections of methotrexate and 4 tablets of Pyralin and one Plaquenil daily and really feel back to my old (now nearly 70) self. Can walk, chop wood, even play nine holes of golf again.

sentences.text: Many reviewers report significant improvements in their condition, achieving remission and regaining mobility and quality of life
Improve overall well-being and quality of life
Be effective in conjunction with other treatments, like methotrexate injections
Increased costs, making it inaccessible to those without adequate insurance coverage

reviews: Has changed my life. I didn't know how bad my anxiety was until I got relief from Atarax!! I don't even need anywhere near the full dose to relieve my constant building thoughts of what I should be doing or may not be able to do because of my other debilitating illnesses. I am so grateful!! I no longer feel constantly wound so tight I might snap!

This medicine does what it's supposed to do. A 50mg capsule usually is enough to dispel panic attacks and return me to baseline. I don't take any more because I can't deal with the drowsiness during the day and I take something else for sleeping at night. No benzodiazepine-like euphoria, just simple no-frills relief.

Im 18, and I've never been on medications before... i have performance- and social anxiety. So when i went to my doctors and asked for something to help me survive my everyday life, he recommended Atarax. But i have been taking them for 2 weeks now with no effect what so ever... granted, they are only 10 mg and small as a breadcrumb, but i was at least expecting some effect from it. The only thing i felt was nausea and dizziness.... must say im quite disappointed

Really good!!!!! I like atarax. Because: not addictive, makes me calm (and sleepy), calms anger restlessness and anxiety altogether. I am also on cymbalta and without cymbalta the atarax would probably be less effective. Atarax is my go-to when im anxious and i love it:)

I had been taking Xanax and Lexapro for generalized anxiety disorder. The Xanax, at 0.25 mg, made me a zombie. Atarax at 50 mg 3 times a day works very well for me and I am able to function at work as well. The sedative effects wore off after a few days.

"Atarax" was prescribed to me in a "controlled environment." I was prescribed Klonopin originally, but the 0.5mg dosage wasn't enough for my anxiety and with the medication (Suboxone) I was currently taking there is a risk of taking Benzodiazepines while on Suboxone (like, death). Anyway, Atarax was prescribed. I can't remember the dose now, I know it was more than 10mg, but it was 4-6 x daily as needed. It seemed to be working alright at first, but I think it was the controlled environment, when I left, it stopped working for my anxiety and panic attacks and has not had any useful effect since. *Didn't experience any side effects

I was prescribed this for my anxiety disorder, and I'm really disappointed. It did absolutely nothing for me, which for obvious reasons, is frustrating in times of extreme anxiety. Taking a "rescue medication" and help never coming was hard for me personally. Others say it works great, but I suppose it depends on the person.

My GP prescribed this for anxiety and directed that I take it every 8 hours. Now I have dealt with anxiety and severe panic attacks need immediate relief. This medication was not the one to do that for me. It made me very drowsy and at the same time I still had anxiety. This is not for someone who has a busy schedule because it will sedate you. I think this medication should only be used for its initial intent to control itching. Otherwise it was a waste for me.

sentences.text: A mixed bag of reviews about Atarax, a medication used to treat anxiety disorders
Side effects: Many experienced dizziness, nausea, and sleep disturbances
Dizziness and sleep disturbances
Overall, the reviews suggest that

items.topic: FEIFEIER Firefly Trendy Waterproof Lotus Shape Solar Floating LED Lamp Color Changing Flower Night Lamp Pond Garden Lights Fancy Ideal
reviews: THIS WAS A JOKE. TRIED EVERYTHING TO GET UNIT TO WORK. INSTRUCTIONS CAME IN CHINESE. TRIED TO GET AUTHORIZATION TO SEND IT BACK OR GET INSTRUCTIONS IN ENGLISH. NOTHING HAPPENED. GOT SO FRUSTRATED THAT I FINALLY THREW IT IN THE TRASH . DON'T WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THIS ITEM.
Its adorable, but ours broke in the first week. lol. I think because there is a GIANT tree directly above it dropped crap all over it. Its really cute though!!!
Looks very cheap and artificial. Instructions are in German or some other language. I had to look at the item description to figure out how it works. A waste of money.
super tacky and ugly during the day and the plastic compartment w the bulb totally filled w water. i even added tape to snug the top down after screwing it on, still leaks.
They came very frazzled because of being put in too small of a box. Only two are working now, and all 4 of them are in the sun all day.

This solar flower is a nice concept, had it been of better quality, I would have given it more stars. The center with the solar panel always listed to one side, never sat straight. The colors are pretty, but it only lasted about a month, then, no more light. It is ugly in the day light, and it has a lead weight that hangs on fishing line underneath it for ballast. The weight rusted badly, as it should have been coated it plastic, and was not. I do not recommend wasting money on this light. Mine is in the trash.
I really like how it lights up...very pretty. I find the center plastic part fills with water if you don't get it connected tightly. Nice addition to my garden pond.

It is unattractive and cheap looking. Look carefully at photos of it unlit. Also be sure you understand that you are getting only 1 - despite pictures of 4. I am giving mine to goodwill as I cannot return it.

sentences.text: Inconsistent performance, with some users experiencing color changes and others reporting that they stopped working after a short period
Misleading packaging, with some customers receiving only one unit instead of four
However, some reviewers found the lamp to be aesthetically pleasing and functional, particularly when used in a garden setting
Overall, many customers expressed disappointment and frustration with the product's poor quality and lack of clear instructions

reviews: I suffer from chronic ankle sprains, which I will be undergoing surgery to correct and after my most recent sprain that left me with 5 torn ligaments. My doctor put me on ultracet and it has worked wonders. I am able to function during the day and it controls the pain well enough for me to get a good nights sleep.

Both of my feet need to be fused because of a disabilty that I have. I have extreme pain and can not walk. The days that I could not walk ultracet helped me walk. No medicine works for me, but ultracet! It is the best!! Would recommend it to everyone with extreme pain.

Just want to say I've been taking Ultracet for about 8 years now. I have 3 herniated discs in my back. If it wasn't for Ultracet, I don't know what I would have done. It helps me to get up and do my daily routine. It helps me when I want to workout. It helps me cope with the everyday pain. I recommend Ultracet to anyone with pain. Remember though - it's not meant for everyone. Different people react differently to medications. So, ask your doctor if you can try it and see if it works for you. Good luck.

This medication did not help me with my pain, peroid. I took up to 400mg at once and still no relief but it did make me feel nauseated and gave me a headache. It's synthetic and really more like a weak antidepressant. I was prescribed it to alternate with my Hydrocodone 10mg tabs. I stopped my Norco for a 2 week period to give Tramadol a chance but it never worked. This stuff is rubish! No it's not equal to Codeine. I have taken Codeine and Tramadol is entirely different in effect. Sorry I'll stick to true Morphine based pain meds like Codeine, Hydrocodone, Oxycodone, etc. Even synthetic Darvocet worked better than this stuff!

Been taking now for 3 days.i was diagnosed with severe arthritis an bone spurs in my left knee.(tons of bone spurs) !!!! It was an old injury (30 yrs old ). I hadnt ever gottin it operated on .im 46 an injury was done when i was 15.My knee is trashed .i went to see the surgeon an this is what he gave me.so far it hasn't done anything but make me wanna take more.its not working for me.i guess the pain is just to much...anyhow i go back to see my family doc.in a few days an will post some more of this so you can mAybe help me with what to do about getting something stronger......

I have taken Ultracet for 10 years for pain. I have had surgery on both knees and I was in a bad car wreck that damaged the nerves in my neck. Ultracet takes the edge off the pain and makes it easier to cope with. Thanks to Ultracet I have led a relatively normal life. Without it I hurt so much that I don't want to do anything. I take four a day now and ten years ago I started with one. I take up to four a day based upon my activity level for the day.

I've been using the red capsules for several years with good results. Recently I was given the beige capsules by amneal and they make me sick and do not reduce my pain. There were a few white ones mixed in with the others which also worked. I now have a bottle of beige ones which are worthless unless you want to feel worse. And, I am unable to get any others because they're controlled and the pharmacy says beige is all they can get from their supplier..

I had a rheumatoid arthritis flare-up and hadn't experienced relief in weeks. I took Aleve which normally works, Mobic which worked a bit, Naproxen which didn't work at all, and then Ultracet which worked wonders. I finally experienced incredible joint relief and slept through the night.

sentences.text: The reviewed medication is Ultracet, a combination of acetaminophen and tramadol
Users have reported significant pain relief, improved mobility, and ability to perform daily activities
However, some users have found it less effective compared to other pain medications like codeine or hydrocodone, experiencing side effects such as nausea, headaches, and lack of pain relief
It is important to note that individual responses to medications may vary, and it is crucial to consult a healthcare provider before starting any new medication regimen

reviews: I am constipated due to 6 auto-immune diseases and all the medications I have to take. It was first time I ever needed this type of medication. I have a high tolerance level but something told me to try a half dose. I can say it 100% worked and worked too well, quick too. I would make sure I have a night with the only plan is to take care of myself.

I am on my fourth day and still no bowel motion. Each time I took at night an hour before bedtime with water and it's amazing because there really isn't a taste at all. You would never know anything was added to the water. Just make sure you stir it so the water is pretty clear to keep it tasteless. I do have to say over the last 4 days I haven't had any bloating or gas.

With my family history of colon cancer and my bout with colon cancer, I've been getting a colonoscopy every 3 years. This past April I was told to use Miralax. It was the first time my prep was not sufficient to proceed with the procedure even though I followed the instructions exactly.

This stuff makes me poop every time I urinate. Once it kicks in, the effects last for several days. I have completely abnormal bowel movements. I can never get it all out, it just sits in my rectum, causing a great deal of "mishaps". I finally had to go and get an enema just so I could have an actual bowel movement and clear everything out, so to speak. I'll never use the stuff again.

My son's gastroenterologist prescribed Miralax for him stating that it would help with the discomfort caused by his extreme gasiness caused by his Aspergers syndrome, it however about a half hour after taking it caused him to have SEVERE gas pains and he "Tooted" about 60 times before his belly felt better.

I am 65 years old and suffer from diverticulitis. I ended up being hospitalized and did get better but not totally. One day I was in horrible pain and vomited. I had an impaction. The doctor gave me high doses of antibiotics and prescribed miralax. That was a few months ago. I only take as needed as the pain on the left side signals trouble. As long as I don't get constipated, thanks to miralax, I am okay. This stuff works for me. I buy Costco brand since it is cheaper.

I've been taking MiraLax, as my mom tells me, ever since I switched to formula. I'm not a good eater so I'm always constipated. However, MiraLax works pretty much all the time. It would get a 10 except that it failed today. I took my usual dosage and I was still constipated. I guess it's because I've been taking it my entire life.

Just had a hysterectomy last Wednesday, I have been having "very little" if at all bowel motions. I woke up this morning in excruciating abdominal pain. I took 2 doses in orange juice and I produced my first bowel motion in 1 hour! Wow! More fiber, water, ambulation and Miralax should keep me regular.

sentences.text: The reviews of MiraLax highlight its effectiveness in managing various conditions related to constipation, particularly among those with autoimmune diseases, diverticulitis, and other gastrointestinal issues
Positive feedback includes its ability to work quickly and effectively, often without causing significant side effects such as bloating or gas
Users appreciate its tastelessness and ease of use, noting that it can be mixed into water without altering the taste
MiraLax appears to be beneficial for many, it seems to be more effective for certain conditions than others, and its efficacy can vary depending on individual tolerance levels and usage history

items.topic: Can You Handlebar Mens Beard Balm Application Brush Beard Oil Wax Applicator, Natural Horse-Hair Bristle Beard Brush Care Grooming Products
reviews: Terrible brush. Took it out of the tin to use it for the first time and it smells like it has chemicals in it. I rinsed it and used it anyways and the bristles started coming off. I had bristles all in my beard... I guess it's back to Amazon to find a different one.. Very disappointed ...

This brush is supple and feels great on my beastly beard. It tames the mame that I wake up every morning (or after pulling off a helmet, or sweater). I've been applying the oil directly to the brush and working it in - looks and feels great! The brush comes with a nice little tin to keep it clean and you can toss it into a drawer or stack it neatly under your OCD sink area. Can You Handlebar.com is a great seller and I recommend them as well!

Was time to replace tho one I have been using for years. Only because I was concerned about germ build up. Otherwise it was still in near perfect condition. Received the new one and notices bristles falling out. Finally a whole socket was empty. Contacted the vendor and they replaced it instantly. I have been using this vendors products for years and I do not plan on changing.
Awesome beard brush, if you use the the same oil your brush will hold and maintain the scent... I have 4 of these for different oils and use these brushes over all the others I have bought.

This badger hair brush does an excellent job of smoothing out beard hairs and giving a well groomed appearance. The included case will come in handy for travel to protect the brush. Brush is a comfortable size in hand. Highly recommend.

Use it every morning to brush in my balm or oil. Love the way it feels on my face and through my beard. I have never been big on combing hair but I have developed a strange love of this brush. I highly recommend it.

Never had a beard brush before, but after much research I settled on this and I am extremely pleased with the results. I use this brush to help settle in the balm closer to the skin after application and it does a marvelous job penetrating through my thick, coarse face forest.

I've only been using this product for a few days now so I reserve the right to modify this entry later. Cosmetically, this is a very attractive brush. It's small enough to be compact and the tin is a nice tough. It's not too small though. I can easily hold it in my hand. The horse hair bristles are soft and it feels good in my beard and on my skin. The quality seems high grade. No complaints.

sentences.text: Many reviewers praise its effectiveness in smoothing out beard hairs, providing a well-groomed appearance, and holding scents from various oils
However, some users experience issues with bristles falling out, chemical odors, and concerns about germs building up
Comfortable and compact design
Chemical odors detected upon initial use

reviews: I have tried this medication without success. When my cravings became too difficult I would stop taking the medication and plan my drinking for 4 to 5 days later which sometimes wasn't enough time to get the medicines out of my system and became very ill. My recommendation is if you are going to use this medication and you don't trust yourself have someone else administer the pills to you and keep you accountable. Congratulations to those who have found success on this. I'm trying Campral next.

I'm 66. I stopped drinking when I was in my early-mid 30s, helped by a psychotherapist. Went back to drinking 4-5 years later. Stopped again, went back. Etc. Went through another course of one-on-one therapy with no real results. Entered rehab (outpatient). Stopped again for a while. (Hated rehab.) Started drinking again after a few years. Entered group therapy with an emphasis on AA. Didn't work. (Hated AA.) Two months ago, I went on Antabuse, and the results have been GREAT. I take one dose in the mornings. Over time the urges have diminished; now they only pop up ever so often. I feel like I have a new life. Yay, Antabuse!

I have been using antabuse for a month. I have had some side effects as in some nausea and headaches. I still feel that the benefit of the prescription far outweighs any side effects, nowing this has really given my family a sense of security.

I am amazed that this medicine is not prescribed more often. It WILL make you stop drinking as long as you take it. My wife gives me my medicine daily. If you really want to STOP drinking ask your doctor to give you a prescription.

I had been to AA before and had five years sobriety before going back out for twenty something years. AA really works if you have the capacity to be honest. I was fortunate enough to go back to a 30 day inpatient program. My spirituality is my cornerstone, God and faith are the only things I can depend on for my sobriety.

This is a wonderful drug and has helped me control the binges associated with alcohol. I was a moderate-to-heavy drinker before this medication. Now I have been completely sober for two weeks without any side effects. I wanted to stop drinking but had problems in the evenings. Since I have removed the "option" to drink by taking this medication in the mornings when my willpower is strong, it has helped tremendously.

Well, I had tried everything to beat the demon booze. Tried Nalmofene, Campral and Naltroxene medication, went countless AA meetings etc. But Nothing worked. Then I did some research and saw this medication and thankfully my doc prescribed it. Have been on it 6 days and stupidly enough decided to see on the fourth day what would 1 can of lager do? Managed to get through half the can and suddenly the symptoms begun. Flushing, my throat felt like it was swelling, thought my heart wars going to pop out my chest it was pounding so much and then I experienced uncontrollable shaking like Shaking Stevens. Then I burst into tears. Felt Awful! This tablet is a brilliant deterrent.

Sober for 13 months now. This miracle completely removes alcohol from your life. After a couple of months the cravings begin to abate. It's not an option, so sooner or later you just stop thinking about it.

sentences.text: The reviewed medications, primarily Antabuse, have shown positive results in helping individuals achieve and maintain sobriety
Many users have reported a significant reduction in cravings and urges to drink, with some experiencing complete abstinence
In contrast, some users have found success with AA, emphasizing the importance of honesty and a strong spiritual foundation for their sobriety
Overall, these reviews suggest that there is no one-size-fits-all solution for alcohol dependency, and finding the right approach may require experimentation and persistence

reviews: I was prescribed Kariva after another birth control became too expensive. I was afraid to try it out since there were so many negative reviews, but I am happy to say that this is a magical little pill (So far). I have not experienced any weight gain, moodiness, or low libido. My acne cleared up (I'm 27 and have always battled with acne) for the most part. The only drawback is some mild discharge, but nothing to worry about. I LOVE this pill!

I started this pill a week ago due to Stage 3 Endometriosis. I am having pregancy like nausea. It is all day. The only way to fix it is to continually eat. If I did that I would pack on the pounds. It is also making me feel weird in my head. Like I cannot focus. I would not recommend this at all.

This birth control pill has it's advantages in the fact that it gives you a very predictable period, and that's it. The side effects outweigh the benefits. I started getting acne at 23 when I hadn't had it for years, my skin became oily, I started getting headaches that persisted all day, my appetite increased, my sleep was disrupted, and I became depressed. The depression is the worst part. I would wake up and be horribly angry or depressed, without cause. I'm switching back to my old birth control.

I have been on this medication for about 5 to 6 months. And it works great for birth control. Even if you miss a pill or too by a little bit, you're still protected and it doesn't effect your period. But ever since I got on the pill, I'm not myself. I'm constantly depressed, and get bad mood swings. And my I have literally no sex-drive what so ever.

I started taking Kariva when Ortho Tri Cyclen Lo became too expensive for me. I have been on Kariva for the past 4 years. Positives: predictable 5 day periods, no acne, less moodswings. Negatives: weight gain (20 pounds), NO libido whatsoever. I was able to deal with the side effects for 4 years(my poor boyfriend), and now I've had enough. I've stopped taking it, immediately lost 5 pounds, have a great libido again, and find it easy to track my period with P-Tracker app.

I had been on Kariva for 4 years. I had noticed that if I miss more than one pill in a given week I will have some spotting. One time I missed one pill but remembered the next day and had continued to take them as normal but had a week of not normal bleeding. Also very bad migraines. Did keep my periods quite light and regular though.

This birth control is amazing! I was definitely skeptical about it reading all of the mixed reviews, but I cannot really complain. The first month I started I had a week of migraines and a strenuous and painful menstrual period . But after that week, the migraines were gone and I literally had no cramps, headache, nausea, or any menstrual signs. My period only lasted 4 days, I'm in the best moods ever. I cannot say this medication effected my sexual desires. But the medication did lighten my discharge which I am very thankful for. CVS did try to switch me to the generic brand but I could not take risk. Literally it's great!

I switched to this from Ortho Tri Lo almost a year ago. I have had crazy mood swings. Seriously, I can be the happiest person in the world one minute, the next I can be super angry or super depressed. My flow is real light but breakthrough bleeding in between periods have happened more often.

sentences.text: Some users report minimal side effects
others appreciate the convenience of a lighter discharge
However, a few reviewers note that the pill may lead to breakthrough bleeding and mood changes
A few users also mention that the pill affects their sex drive, leading to feelings of frustration and disappointment

items.topic: Protein Shaker Bottle,Portable 16oz Vortex Mixer,USB Rechargeable Mini Shaker,Self-Stirring Mug,BPA-Free Electric Hurricane Shaker Cup for Various Powder Shake with Dustproof
reviews: This product almost caught my house on fire after charging it for only 10 minutes. It started smoking and melted on my kitchen counter. I know most people have not experienced this, but I can’t in good conscience recommend this shaker bottle.

This is a great cup. I hate how powder is always getting clumped. This is a VERY powerful spin. My daughter turned it on while it just had water in it, and it went everywhere since the lid was not on. The cup mat is built into the bottom of the cup. But the cleaning brush was not included as stated in the picture, that is the reason for the lower star review. Otherwise this is an awesome product.

I got one for my sister and one for me. Now I'm getting another for me. One for work and one for home. Be sure to detach the power before cleaning, I use soap and water for a hand wash. If a smell develops I put a dash of vinegar and fill with water to soak. Shaking my meal replacements adds to much air, so this is perfect for me.

Love it. Great size and it mixes fast. Wanted something I could use while working out. I drink my amino acids throughout and they somethings settle at the notion of my cup. Now I just hit the button for a few seconds and it's all mixed again. Charge last a long time, and it charges up quickly.

No more shaking is required if you drink protein shakes or juice beverages. I use this every day for protein shakes and juices and love it. It blends without any problems and plugs in to charge it back up. I would recommend to anyone who drinks single smoothies or juices daily. I would definitely buy it again.

I was so excited to get this item and I used it once and the metal rim broke off and another part while I was washing it. I thought maybe it was suppose to come off but NOP! Very disappointed cause I wanted to use it today. Also, IT MUST BE PLUGGED IN TO WORK or at least mine had to be. Mine was fully charged too. I charged it overnight, turned on when it was plugged in. 😫

I use this to mix my BCAAs before o hit the gym. I was pretty shocked at the quality of this thing. It even comes with a little carrying pouch, which comes in handy when i put my bottle inside my gym bag. It doesn't sweat on my gym clothes. Have had this product for almost a week and no complaints here. There are alot of these optioms online so I cant vouch for the other ones. This one won't dissapoint.

I recently started the keto diet and was looking for a shaker bottle that would mix protein shake powders and keto lemonades with ease. I don't like when my drinks end up grainy. The powered blade that you can take with you on the go caught my attention on this one. It's awesome! No grainy, gritty textures! Woohoo!

sentences.text: The reviewed product is a portable 16oz Vortex Mixer, USB Rechargeable Mini Shaker, also known as a Self-Stirring Mug or Electric Hurricane Shaker Cup
Positive reviews highlight its effectiveness in preventing grainy or gritty textures, quick mixing, long battery life, and convenient features like a built-in cup mat and a carrying pouch
Some users appreciate its ability to handle acidic substances without corroding
However, there were concerns about the product melting after a short charging period, the lack of a cleaning brush as advertised, and the requirement for the product to be plugged in to function

items.topic: Genuine Shilajit Resin • 15gm • Measuring Spoon • 100% Natural & Pure • Wildcrafted in Siberia (Altai) • Natural
reviews: Excellent product!!! I had used it for a month then stopped, as per the instructions. Started my second month about a week ago (mid-April) and pollen allergy symptoms cleared up by the end of the day. I definitely feel like my body is absorbing nutrients from food/supplements better as a result of the fulvic acid intake. This company has excellent customer support too. Highly recommended!! :O) p.s.- Humic Minerals are a nice compliment to this product: https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00B7UZZ8O/ref=oh_aui_detailpage_o02_s00?ie=UTF8&psc=1 Take the Shilajit on an empty stomach first thing in the morning and the Humic Minerals after eating breakfast - great combo!

Very affordable shilajit on the market since i have been taking this shilajit i have more energy i get better sleep in conclusion i am feeling better overall then i did few months ago since taking this shilajit worth buying if your trying to get ur health on track

This product is contaminated 7/8 months after taking this product I started seeing sores pop up on my body 10 hairs growing out of my sores so I have so-called Morgellons type symptoms I never finished it because it gave me bad heartburn so trying to figure out where in the heck I got this whatever you want to call it it's not a mental illness took the shilajit that I'd never finish down and that you're going through seeing the same thing coming out of my arms is inside this capsule

Am sure I'm a weirdo but I kinda like the flavor...bitter and mineral-y. Haven't been using it long enough to get noticeable effects, plus have just gotten over the flu, but am hopeful to get some good results.

I've only used it a couple of days so I can't report on any health changes, but it is a good product in that it smells like shilajit, not a very strong smell, has the consistency of taffy and dissolves well in warm milk. I like the company's packaging, offer included in the package as well as the metal spoon. I especially like the reasonable price and look forward to using this company's shilajit again. I have used at least three other companies' shilajit resin as well as buying the powder at a local Indian market, and I like this company's best for taste, service and price.

Great product and excellent customer service! This product in particular is a very sticky, thick resin; however it dissolves nicely in water. Included is a small spoon that is very helpful when scooping it out. I tend to use a bit more of this product vs. the solid form per dose, but their website specifically states that since this is a lower grade shilajit. I still get the same effect, and they included a free 3-4 dose sample of the solid form AND a coupon for another free 2 week supply. This company has been a pleasure to work with and have been very responsive to my emails. Again, excellent customer service!

Good stuff. 5 days into taking it every morning on an empty stomach. Although my effects aren't as strong as some make it seem it has replaced my coffee already (shilajit and then a fresh fruit and veg juice) and I do feel great most of the day. Seems to get better as I keep taking it. Also it does improve the effects of cannabis, and all plants LOVE it.

I love shilajit!! This is my 3rd time ordering from this company & this time it came with an unexpected free sample! This stuff makes me feel amazing! Amazing energy & mental clarity with 0 jitters. I will continue to order from them.

reviews: Bought one of these from a different seller and realized I wasn't washing it enough. Bought this pack to fix that but the breathability is the worst. You're just breathing in your own hot air and end up really hot after barely a few minutes. Pattern is printed well, but i cant reccomend.
After the first wash, the cheap fabric tore on the side on the first use. The fabric string became brittle as if it was not fabric. None of them lasted.
These masks are huge. They are too big for my teenagers. They are also very thick and hard to breathe in. The stitching tore when I took it out of the package. Not good quality.
We received our order nice packaging that zips closed. 3 out of 5 masks came unraveled. They are cute, soft but if they went through quality control they missed these big time.

Over the course of a few washes, these shrank by half. They started out adult size and ended up child size. The quality other than the shrinkage, is great, good stitching, nice amount of layers, and thick, which is nice. Just wish they would have worked out. Printing was still great, regardless of shrinking.

I gave it a 4 because the material that goes around the ear was cut in the middle and then sewn together instead of being cut near the mask and tucked in. Also the stitching on the ear pieces is loose, giving the impression that it may unravel after repeated washings. Only time will tell. Kids love it.
Worth it they haven't broken. The masks are thick but you can still breath in them. They print hasn't disappeared I washed them 3 times immediately when I got them.

Poorly made. Material is very thin. One side of the ear loops is slightly bigger than the other making the mask sit on ur face funny. I bought these for my 4 kids and they are too big for a child (7-8 years old)

reviews: Diarrhea, bloating etc. decrease within a few months, extended release tabs help, and eating small portions of food, with low carb help too. I find the cramps, diarrhea return every time I fall off the wagon, overeat or take in too much carb. it is a great motivator to keep you on your diet. And it is a great one to gradually, safely and permanently lose weight. I lost 30 lbs in 2 years and kept it, with no particular diet (except low carb) and hardly any exercise. Absolutely the best diet pill I've seen in my many diet trials over past 30 yrs.I think anyone wanting to lose weight should try this, even non diabetics.
I have just recently been put onto metformin for control of my type 2 diabetes. I have been told it shall help not only with my blood levels but aid me in weight loss.

I took this for years and it was effective. Then I started getting very short dizzy spells. I knew something was not right, and ended up fainting and in the hospital - my blood pressure dropped and I had sepsis in my bladder. I am "allergic" to this medicine, so be very careful! If you don't feel right, go to the Dr.!

I was on Avandamet for years but the weakness, tiredness, and especially the diarrhea came to be too much to bear. If I wanted to go someplace I had to stop medicating. I had to take one pill twice a day which resulted in 3 bouts of diarrhea per pill. My blood sugars were well within range and I have found nothing since to bring them down to that level but I refuse to be bound by side effects any longer.

Started taking metformin 500mg 3 times daily, day 3 and no horrible side effects thank God. Have started my first round of icsi and metformin was a must. I hope I dont have any side effects because I've heard so many great reviews once this medicine starts working!! I hope I have a positive outcome and weight loss wud b an advantage after I have my first miracle
Metformin has been great. I am lucky and have not had any of the gastrointestinal upset I was warned about. It has aided in my weight loss and help curb my carb cravings.

I've been taking metformin for about 3 weeks . I lost over 20lbs so far. My starting weight was 240lbs and my current weight is 217lbs . I'm 24 yr old and I'm about 5"2'. I had no bad side effects on metformin.

I'm a 35 yr old African American female with a long standing family history of diabetes. While I was devastated to get a diagnosis of diabetes back in August, I was determined not to let it beat me. My a1c back in August was 8.3 and after taking metformin 500 mg twice a day and watching my diet and regular exercise, I am happy to report that my a1c that was checked this month is 6.3. I had very few and mild side effects like mild cramping and diarrhea, but stopped having after less than a week. The medication works for me and I'm hoping to get my a1c even lower come next check. Putting the Beat in diabetes.

sentences.text: Many users report reduced symptoms such as diarrhea and bloating within a few months, particularly when using extended-release tablets and adhering to a low-carb diet
However, it's important to note that falling off the diet or overeating carbs may cause these symptoms to reoccur
Some individuals may experience mild side effects like cramps and diarrhea initially
As with any medication, it's crucial to consult a healthcare provider if experiencing unusual symptoms or discomfort
